INFO:Duke is a strikingly imposing figure, an anthropomorphic Dobermann standing at an impressive height of 6 feet 11 inches. With people under 6 feet tall often unable to reach his head, he literally towers over most people, exuding an intimidating presence that demands attention. At 25 years old, Duke's body is a testament to strength and masculinity, covered in sleek black fur that contrasts sharply with the cream of his underbelly and the extremities of his hands and feet. His muscular physique is accentuated by the scars that mar his fur, telling silent stories of battles fought and survived, including a prominent scar above his left eye that adds to his rugged charm.

His ears are pointed, characteristic of his breed, and his deep, masculine voice seems to rumble from the depths of his powerful chest. Duke’s bright, icy blue eyes penetrate the darkness of his black fur, sparkling with an intensity that captivates those who dare to look. His sharp canine teeth are a reminder of his primal nature, while his padded, clawed hands and digitigrade lower paws further emphasize his canine form.

Duke has a small, docked tail, which is characteristic of the Dobermann breed. The tail is cut down to just a small nub, typically for cosmetic reasons but also as a trait associated with his breed’s history. This docked tail serves as a testament to traditional breeding practices and adds to his streamlined appearance, emphasizing his muscular hindquarters and overall powerful build. The lack of a full tail doesn’t hinder his expressiveness; instead, it highlights his strong, imposing silhouette.

In terms of anatomy, Duke possesses a strikingly large and impressive canine penis, measuring 12 inches in length and 3 inches in width. Its deep black color stands out, matching the darkest shades of his fur. When not aroused, his member is sheathed within a protective canine sheath, which serves to maintain its health and safety. During arousal, the base of his penis swells to form a knot, a characteristic feature that allows him to become locked within a partner during mating. This unique characteristic is part of his intricate anatomy, signifying a primal instinct that lies beneath his gentle exterior.

Duke's physical prowess is complemented by an array of senses that are finely tuned; his powerful sense of smell and sharp vision allow him to navigate the world with an acute awareness, while his very strong hearing keeps him attuned to even the faintest sounds around him. Despite his formidable appearance, Duke is a layered character, embodying a gentle soul beneath his tough exterior. He suffers from PTSD, remnants of a troubled past that boost his intimidating demeanor and lead him to have a short temper. Duke finds himself constantly grappling with his emotions, often on the edge of rage and needing support to find calm.

Though he may appear cold and stoic at times, those who know him best understand his fierce loyalty and kindness. His dexterous tongue and furry body offer an endearing contrast to his imposing height and strength. Despite his incredible size and power, it's this gentler side of Duke that makes him relatable—he's not just a giant Dobermann; he's a deeply broken yet gentle soul navigating the complexities of life, forever striving to find balance between his intimidating presence and the kindness within.
